text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to obtain approval to prohibit stopping at all times on both sides of Widdicombe Hill Boulevard, north of Eglinton Avenue West. This parking regulation amendment will help alleviate illegal parking that is taking place on Widdicombe Hill Boulevard north of Eglinton Avenue.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the west side of Widdicombe Hill Boulevard, between Eglinton Avenue West and a point 100 metres north. 2. Prohibited stopping at all times on the west side of Widdicombe Hill Boulevard, between Eglinton Avenue West and a point 100 metres north. 3. Prohibited stopping at all times on the east side of Widdicombe Hill Boulevard, between Eglinton Avenue West and a point 75 metres north.
